title: HostFormVersionFilterDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of one published native form version's answer filters: the questions the response inbox can filter by, exactly as listOrganizerFormResponses returns them as answerFilterOptions for that version. Written by a trigger on organizerFormVersions, which are immutable. Never answers, never the version definition, and never identity, permission or mutation authority.
x-owner: Host read model projector (hostReadModels form version filter trigger)

formVersion.description: The published version number N of versionId (formId_vN).
